summary: Create executable scripts to pull similar Command Centre, Ops Dashboard, Symbio, Synapse, Pen and Bridge repos into a timestamped temp folder, extract matching files, generate indexes, and write receipt artifacts.

deliverables.purpose: Clone known similar GitHub repos, inventory files, extract command/dashboard/control-plane files, grep signal hits, produce zip.
Explain execution, outputs, safety, and evidence contract.
Record file creation, run result, extracted file counts, and zip path.

script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

STAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
BASE="${T4H_PULL_BASE:-$HOME/Downloads/T4H_CommandCentre_Pull_$STAMP}"
mkdir -p "$BASE"/{repos,extracted,logs,receipts}

cd "$BASE/repos"

REPOS=(
  "https://github.com/TML-4PM/mcp-command-centre.git"
  "https://github.com/TML-4PM/ops-dashboard.git"
  "https://github.com/TML-4PM/the-pen.git"
)

for repo in "${REPOS[@]}"; do
  name="$(basename "$repo" .git)"
  echo "==> Cloning $name"
  if [ -d "$name/.git" ]; then
    git -C "$name" pull --ff-only 2>&1 | tee "$BASE/logs/${name}_pull.log" || true
  else
    git clone "$repo" "$name" 2>&1 | tee "$BASE/logs/${name}_clone.log" || echo "FAILED $name" | tee -a "$BASE/logs/failures.log"
  fi
done

cd "$BASE"

find repos -type f \
  -not -path "*/node_modules/*" \
  -not -path "*/.git/*" \
  -not -path "*/dist/*" \
  -not -path "*/build/*" \
  -not -path "*/.next/*" \
  | sort > "$BASE/file_inventory.txt"

while IFS= read -r f; do
  case "$f" in
    *command*|*Command*|*centre*|*Centre*|*center*|*Center*|*dashboard*|*Dashboard*|*portfolio*|*Portfolio*|*surface*|*Surface*|*navigation*|*Navigation*|*bridge*|*Bridge*|*runtime*|*Runtime*|*ops*|*Ops*|*symbio*|*Symbio*|*synapse*|*Synapse*|*pen*|*Pen*)
      dest="$BASE/extracted/$f"
      mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
      cp "$f" "$dest"
      ;;
  esac
done < "$BASE/file_inventory.txt"

grep -RInE "PortfolioSurface|Navigation|Dashboard|Command Centre|command centre|bridge|runtime|Supabase|supabase|VITE_|VERCEL|Pen|Symbio|Synapse|OODA|evidence|work_queue|system_registry" \
  "$BASE/repos" \
  --exclude-dir=.git \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules \
  --exclude-dir=dist \
  --exclude-dir=build \
  --exclude-dir=.next \
  > "$BASE/focused_hits.txt" || true

for d in "$BASE"/repos/*; do
  [ -d "$d/.git" ] || continue
  {
    echo "### $(basename "$d")"
    git -C "$d" remote -v
    git -C "$d" branch --show-current
    git -C "$d" log --oneline -n 20
    echo
  } >> "$BASE/repo_status.txt"
done

EXTRACTED_COUNT="$(find "$BASE/extracted" -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
INVENTORY_COUNT="$(wc -l < "$BASE/file_inventory.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

cat > "$BASE/receipts/command-centre-pull-bundle.receipt.json" <<JSON
{
  "idempotency_key": "command-centre-pull-bundle-20260429-001",
  "completed_at": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "base": "$BASE",
  "inventory_count": $INVENTORY_COUNT,
  "extracted_count": $EXTRACTED_COUNT,
  "evidence": [
    "$BASE/file_inventory.txt",
    "$BASE/focused_hits.txt",
    "$BASE/repo_status.txt",
    "$BASE/extracted"
  ]
}
JSON

cd "$(dirname "$BASE")"
zip -qr "$(basename "$BASE").zip" "$(basename "$BASE")"

echo "DONE"
echo "Folder: $BASE"
echo "Zip: $(dirname "$BASE")/$(basename "$BASE").zip"
echo "Receipt: $BASE/receipts/command-centre-pull-bundle.receipt.json"

done_when: script exists in repo or worker workspace
